description: This file defines a FastAPI router for uploading documents. It includes a route '/documents/upload' that accepts a multipart file upload, processes the document asynchronously, and returns a structured response.

classes.name: DocumentUploadResponse
classes.description: Pydantic model for the response after upload, containing extracted data from the document.

methods.name: upload_document(file: UploadFile = File(...), username: str = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Endpoint to upload a document. Receives a file and authenticated user, processes the document asynchronously, and returns the extraction result.

ctags.name: upload_document
ctags.pattern: /^async def upload_document(file: UploadFile = File(...), username: str = Depends(get_current_user/
